Write clean, maintainable, and thoroughly tested code across both client and server-side components. Stay up-to-date with the latest Node.js, React.js, and Next.js trends, features, and best practices. Develop and maintain all server-side network components using Node.js and Express.js. Ensure optimal performance and responsiveness of applications, integrating with front-end and external APIs seamlessly. Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams (UI/UX, QA, DevOps) to ensure smooth integration and timely delivery. Contribute to architecture and design discussions, ensuring scalability, maintainability, and performance. Qualifications Education Qualification Bachelor or Masters Degree Must Have Skills 5+ years of professional experience in Node.js and React.js development, working on scalable production-grade applications. Strong understanding of React Flow for building interactive diagrams, node-based workflows, or process visualizations. Comprehensive knowledge of ES6+, TypeScript, and advanced JavaScript OOP principles. Strong understanding of Next.js for SSR, routing, data fetching, and application structure. Deep knowledge of React concepts, hooks, component optimization, and performance tuning. Understanding of RESTful APIs, GraphQL, HTML, CSS, and version control (Git, GitHub, GitLab, or SVN). Experience with both relational and non-relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB). Proficiency with front-end build tools such as Webpack, Vite, Gulp, or Rollup.js. Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and DOM manipulation. Strong problem-solving and debugging ability across client and server contexts. Primary Skills Tools Excellent organizational and time management capabilities. Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills. Effective communication, team collaboration, and mentoring ability. Experience in microservices architecture, middleware development, Node.js (Express.js), and CRON job management. Experience with Swagger/OpenAPI documentation, Postman testing, and JavaScript/TypeScript test cases (Jest, Mocha). Familiarity with caching mechanisms (Redis, Memcached) and background task processing. Good To Have Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes). Understanding of DevOps workflow, build automation, and deployment orchestration. Knowledge of web security best practices, token-based authentication (JWT, OAuth2). Experience deploying and maintaining applications on cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP. Experience in Next.js performance optimization techniques such as dynamic imports, ISR, and image optimization. Familiarity with frontend testing frameworks (Cypress, Playwright, React Testing Library). Exposure to real-time event-driven systems using WebSockets, Socket.IO, or SignalR.
